templates.name: Guide · deck overview
templates.purpose: The internal guide at the front of a pick deck: the narrative, the sections like an agenda, how to use the deck and an internal-use note. A stamp marks it as not for clients.

body.text: This deck is a library, not a story told start to finish. Each section answers one buyer question for Northfield Health System, from why change now to what happens next. Pull only the slides that fit the buyer and the moment.

items: Start with the buyer and the reason to act.
Pick the sections that match the conversation.
Choose depth: one slide, or the full set.
Close with proof and one clear next step.

body.text: Internal use only: remove this guide and every section guide before sharing the deck externally.
